p: 1 | 2d4 gnomes riding rabbits.
2 | 3 pilgrims trudge along the dusty road, an old man and two young men. Simple travellers? Or are they more than they seem?
3 | A 12 foot wooden post stands beside the road. Something pale flutters on the top of it.
4 | A baby dragon cries loudly as it staggers about in the centre of the road.
5 | A band of children, hungry and footsore, who earnestly claim to be on a crusade to the Holy Land.
6 | A band of elves run past.
7 | A band of foreign pilgrims on a sacred quest to find a magic tome.
8 | A band of foreigners/non-humans in garb the group don't recognise halt the PCs and ask urgent questions in a language nobody understands.
9 | A band of grim-faced knights halt the party at a crossroads while they bury the still-gnashing head of a necromancer.
10 | A band of kobold hunters hides and watches the road for human prey.
11 | A band of lepers or plague-carriers on their way to a nearby spring with supposed healing properties.
12 | A band of orcs runs toward the party. They look over their shoulders and try to run through the party. Something dreadful has terrified them, something behind them, ahead of the party.
13 | A band of ragged urchins make half-hearted attempts to pickpocket travellers.
14 | A band of rowdy centaurs camp beside the road, scaring away the peasants who work the nearby fields.
15 | A band of sprites, pixies and other fey block a narrow bridge and demand a toll in the form of a performance from each traveler.
16 | A band of travelling minstrels challenge the wisest looking member of the party to a storytelling contest.
17 | A band of twenty storm giants are incredibly stupid and bad at math. When they capture travelers they can be "paid off" for one copper coin each.
18 | A band of young halflings stroll by happily, playing musical instruments. They salute the PCs as they pass and try to pickpocket them.

19 | A bandit steps out of the woods before you and demands passage (1 gold piece per traveler). If challenged, he claims his men are hidden in the woods ready to shoot at his command. He takes a step backwards and a crossbow bolt embeds itself in the ground before him.
20 | A bard sits on a rock, singing songs about people walking along the road in that moment.
21 | A bare-knuckle fight in a dusty ring on the roadside. Crowd size?
22 | A battalion of soldiers approach the party on the way to battle. Their commander tries to "recruit" the party into her fighting force.
23 | A battered chest lies off to the side.
24 | A battle-scarred and seasoned warrior crashes from the undergrowth and screams, "Run! For the love of the Gods! They're coming!" and races terrified down the road.
25 | A bear carcass blocks the road.
26 | A bear cub has caught its foot under a root beside the road. Mother bear is getting more distressed by the wails of the panicky cub.
27 | A beat up, screaming princess flees a fire rhino ridden by a knight in molten armor.
28 | A beautiful farmer's daughter runs the roadside fruit stand.
29 | A beautiful magical thing - such as a dryad or unicorn - flees from a mage. It's afraid and seeks help from the PCs.
30 | A beautiful woman, adorned in the robes of an enchantress, emerges from hiding near the road and implores you to lend her aid.
31 | A beehive buzzes angrily on a branch overhanging the road, and beneath it a figure lies gasping and puffy with dozens of stings.
32 | A beggar on the road is actually a shape-changed demon.
33 | A beheaded giant's corpse lies across the road, blocking it.
34 | A belligerent drunk wanders into the group's path demanding alcohol, money and to marry their horse.
35 | A bend on the coastal road made smooth and slippery by the sea water splashing and spraying over it, brings risk of falling into the sea.
36 | A big winged predator eats its prey in the middle of the road.
37 | A black sack lies abandoned at the roadside. Something inside moves.
38 | A blood covered map case lies beside the road.
39 | A bloodied old man cries for help.
40 | A boisterous wedding party dances towards the PCs.
41 | A book filled with illustrations of a wealthy family lays by the road side.
42 | A bounty hunter rides past, leading a badly-beaten captive on a chain who struggles to keep pace.
43 | A bounty hunter with a prisoner would like to join the PCs until the next town. The prisoner likes the opportunities this brings.
44 | A box of hand tools lies scattered in the weeds at the edge of the road. You notice broken twigs next to the box and trampled grass leading further in the field.
45 | A boy rushes from a dilapidated, roadside tower claiming he has found the hideout of local bandits.
46 | A brand-new shoe lies on the trail.
47 | A bridge crosses a river of fog - no not fog - a river of spirits or ghosts.
48 | A bridge is missing. Where it used to be is now a ferry service, for a sizable fee. The ferry looks like it might consist of bridge parts, and only takes a few travelers at a time.
49 | A bright yellow sign with black markings seems to represent a man holding a tool of some sort.
50 | A brightly colored fair with many wagons, minstrels, jugglers and acrobats. They struggle with an exotic beast attempting to break its last chain.
51 | A broken holy symbol inhabits one of the deep, encrusted, muddy boot prints on the side of the road.
52 | A bugbear and his bride ride by in a royal carriage.
53 | A bull, larger than any you have ever seen, snorts and rampages about the road destructively.
54 | A burly man sits next to a hay-wagon with a broken wheel. He waves in despair when he notices you.
55 | A burned cart rests in the center of the road. On the body of the driver (or rider) is an urgent message for one of the PCs.
56 | A burned cart rests in the center of the road. The attacker is still at the scene, devouring or looting the corpse of the driver.
57 | A burnt-out toll-station, with the murdered bodies of the toll inspectors still scattered around.
58 | A butcher hangs fresh kills on poles on his custom made meat wagon.
59 | A cage hangs at the crossroads. Within, a prisoner laments his false imprisonment. He claims to be innocent of the murder of which he stands accused, and begs for release.
60 | A campsite with several recently used fire pits is by the side of the road. Hastily abandoned? Sign of battle? Strange footprints?
